learning_outcomes.text: Identify the main components of a modern processor, describe their functionality, and demonstrate how they each contribute to program execution
Evaluate computer system based on their design, and assess their impact on program performance
Design and develop simple programs in assembly language

syllabus_topics: Structure and function of modern computers
Computer components: execution pipeline, memory subsystem, data storage, external devices
In-depth analysis of how the processor interprets and performs a program
Trade-offs in processor design and their impact on performance
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a 120-minute written exam. Up to 10% bonus can be achieved through homework assignments. Credits are awarded upon successful completion of the exam.
